description: TASK A audit report + the full VERIFY gauntlet. Runs LAST so it verifies the fixes from FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 together on the integrated worktree. Performs the required verification suite end-to-end and writes a fresh, honest report to .agents/tasks/magnet-final/AUDIT.md covering backend security, frontend, data, consistency, Slope, a 'Deployment readiness' section (TASK B), dependency sanity, and a 'Residual recommendations' section for risky/opinion items left unchanged. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being complete. Does NOT deploy, does NOT change DNS, does NOT push beyond committing the report.
steps: Dependency sanity: run `npm install` (expect clean, 0 vulnerabilities today) and `npm audit` (report only high/critical; fix only if trivial AND safe, else log). Record results.
Static checks: `npm test` (expect 20 pass). `node --check` on every server/**/*.js and js/*.js (22 files today; all must pass). Record the counts.

Boot WITHOUT a DB using the exact command in context.json (DATABASE_URL pointed at an unreachable host, PORT 3999). Confirm the server boots, migration logs 'skipped (DB unavailable)', and GET returns 200 for: / /book.html /account.html /subjects.html /pricing.html /css/styles.css /js/config.js /data/subjects.json /assets/logo.png /api/me, and GET /api/me returns JSON {"user":null}. Kill the server. Record the status table.

Boot WITH local Postgres (psql is at /opt/homebrew/bin/psql): start/locate a local Postgres, create a scratch database, set DATABASE_URL to it and ADMIN_EMAIL to a test address, run `npm run migrate` then `npm run seed:admin`, boot the server, and exercise the full flow over HTTP with a cookie jar: POST /api/register -> POST /api/login -> POST /api/bookings (session cookie attached) -> GET /admin as the admin (confirm the booking renders, HTML-escaped) -> POST /api/admin/credits to grant a +4 bundle -> GET /api/account and confirm balance reflects the grant. Drop the scratch DB and stop the scratch server afterward. If local Postgres genuinely cannot be started, state that explicitly in AUDIT.md and move on (do not fail the feature for a missing local DB).

Lighthouse: with js/config.js BACKEND_ENABLED=false (as in the repo), serve the site statically via `python3 -m http.server <port>` (or through the Express server) and run lighthouse desktop headless (Chrome at /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome) on index, subjects, pricing, book, reviews, account, about, tutors, faq. REQUIRE every category = 100 and CLS = 0 with ZERO console errors on each. Explicitly confirm account.html makes NO /api request in static mode (check the Lighthouse network records or a separate headless console check). If any page regresses below 100 or shows a console error or CLS > 0, fix the root cause (it is a real regression), re-run, and only then record the passing table. Stop the static server afterward.

Security/secrets/trackers: confirm `git check-ignore .env` prints .env and `.env` is untracked; grep the whole live tree for committed secrets; confirm NO 'best seller' phrasing in live files; grep assets/slope for adsbygoogle/googletagmanager/pagead/google-analytics/gtag and confirm none; confirm Slope loads only on the 5-click logo (easter-egg.js fetches nothing on normal page load).

Write .agents/tasks/magnet-final/AUDIT.md: a fresh report with (a) Verification results (every command above + its outcome, including the boot-without-DB route table and the with-DB flow result or an explicit 'no local Postgres' note, and the full Lighthouse table), (b) What was fixed (fold in FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 findings), (c) What was checked and found correct per area (backend auth/SQL/validation/credits/index-setup/db/admin; frontend 10 pages + JSON-LD + js + css; data; consistency; Slope), (d) a 'Deployment readiness' section (TASK B: DEPLOY.md now includes the BACKEND_ENABLED flip; render.yaml/.env.example/package.json/.gitignore verified; secrets hygiene), and (e) 'Residual recommendations' for risky/opinion items left unchanged (e.g. CSP disabled for the inline theme script, Render free-tier cold start + free Postgres expiry, published personal phone number, library permission, unused MA.webp, the cosmetic .notfound-wheel class name, book.html subject option values vs subjects.json display names). Reference real file paths. Keep verbatim quoting of any external material under 30 consecutive words.
Commit the report (and any Lighthouse-regression fixes) to main with a message like 'docs: full re-audit report + deployment-readiness for magnet-final'. Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` is clean and `npm audit` high/critical findings are reported (and fixed only if trivial/safe, else logged) in AUDIT.md.
`npm test` passes all tests and `node --check` is clean on every server/**/*.js and js/*.js; counts recorded in AUDIT.md.
Boot-without-DB route table in AUDIT.md shows 200 for all 10 listed paths and /api/me returning {"user":null}.
The with-local-Postgres register->login->booking->admin->grant-bundle->balance flow is executed and its outcome recorded (or an explicit statement that local Postgres was unavailable).
Lighthouse table in AUDIT.md shows every category = 100 and CLS = 0 with zero console errors for all 9 pages, and account.html is confirmed to make no /api call when BACKEND_ENABLED=false.

AUDIT.md confirms .env gitignored + untracked, no committed secrets, no 'best seller' phrasing, and no trackers in assets/slope; and includes a 'Deployment readiness' section and a 'Residual recommendations' section.
AUDIT.md is committed to main with a clear message; nothing is pushed.
verification: npm install  (expect clean) ; npm audit  (expect 0 vulnerabilities today; report high/critical if any)
for f in $(ls server/*.js server/**/*.js js/*.js 2>/dev/null); do node --check "$f" || echo FAIL $f; done  (expect: no FAIL)

boot-without-DB per context.json then: for p in / /book.html /account.html /subjects.html /pricing.html /css/styles.css /js/config.js /data/subjects.json /assets/logo.png /api/me; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} '$p'\n' http://127.0.0.1:3999$p; done  (expect: 200 for each) ; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3999/api/me  (expect: {"user":null})
lighthouse headless desktop on the 9 pages  (expect: Performance/Accessibility/Best-Practices/SEO all 100 and CLS 0, no console errors)
git check-ignore .env  (expect: .env) ; grep -rilE 'adsbygoogle|googletagmanager|pagead|google-analytics|gtag' assets/slope  (expect: no matches)
test -f .agents/tasks/magnet-final/AUDIT.md && grep -iq 'Deployment readiness' .agents/tasks/magnet-final/AUDIT.md && echo OK  (expect: OK)
git log --oneline -1  (expect the audit-report commit on main)
findings:
Full VERIFY gauntlet run on the integrated worktree (after FEAT-001 + FEAT-002). Wrote a fresh honest report to .agents/tasks/magnet-final/AUDIT.md and committed it to main. NO source regressions found; the only change this feature introduces is AUDIT.md.
RESULTS: (1) npm install clean, npm audit = 0 vulnerabilities (94 pkgs). (2) npm test = 20/20 pass; node --check clean on all 21 server/**/*.js + js/*.js (context said ~22; actual is 21: 12 server + 9 js). (3) Boot WITHOUT DB (DATABASE_URL at unreachable host, PORT 3999): migration logged 'skipped (DB unavailable)', server kept serving; all 10 routes returned 200 (/ /book.html /account.html /subjects.html /pricing.html /css/styles.css /js/config.js /data/subjects.json /assets/logo.png /api/me) and /api/me returned {"user":null}. (4) Boot WITH local Postgres (postgresql@16 running, psql at /opt/homebrew/bin/psql): scratch DB magnet_scratch_feat003 created, migrated, ADMIN_EMAIL set; full flow passed over a cookie jar: register (role resolved admin) -> login -> POST booking (status server-set 'requested') -> GET /admin (markup HTML-ESCAPED: raw <script> count 0, escaped count 1, escaped <b> count 1) -> POST /api/admin/credits +4 bundle (302 redirect, HTML-form path) -> GET /api/account balance=4. Scratch DB dropped. (5) Lighthouse 13.6.0 desktop headless, BACKEND_ENABLED stayed false, served via the Express server: ALL 9 pages (index/subjects/pricing/book/reviews/account/about/tutors/faq) = 100/100/100/100, CLS 0.000, ZERO console errors; account.html made 0 /api requests (verified from network records). An initial python3 -m http.server sweep showed account P=86/CLS=0.270 and a tutors ERR_CONNECTION_RESET; re-running each page in isolation returned 100s/CLS0/0-errors, proving those were single-threaded-dev-server concurrency artifacts (account's layout-shift-elements list was empty), NOT real regressions -> no source fix needed. (6) Security/secrets/trackers: git check-ignore .env -> .env; .env untracked (only .env.example tracked); broad git grep found no committed secrets; no 'best seller' phrasing in any live file; no adsbygoogle/googletagmanager/pagead/google-analytics/gtag in assets/slope; easter-egg.js fetches nothing on load (Unity loader + slope.json only inside launch() on the 5-click trigger).
AUDIT.md sections written: Verification results (with the no-DB route table, the with-DB flow table, and the full 9-page Lighthouse table), What was fixed (folding FEAT-001 DEPLOY.md flip + FEAT-002 reviews.html content), What was checked and found correct per area (backend auth/SQL/validation/credits/db/admin; frontend 10 pages + JSON-LD + js + css; data; consistency; Slope), Deployment readiness (TASK B: DEPLOY.md flip step present; render.yaml/.env.example/package.json/.gitignore verified; secrets hygiene; free-tier caveat), and Residual recommendations (CSP disabled for inline theme script, Render free-tier cold start + free Postgres expiry, published personal phone, library-as-venue permission, unused MA.webp, the .notfound-wheel class name -- noted it is actually USED by 404.html, so a naming nitpick not dead code --, book.html subject option values vs subjects.json display names, reviews.json empty by design).
CONSTRAINTS HONORED: committed AUDIT.md to main with a conventional-commit message; did NOT deploy, did NOT change DNS, did NOT push; no risky refactors, no file moves, no CSS-class renames; js/config.js left BACKEND_ENABLED:false. All scratch DBs/servers/temp files cleaned up.
